subject.title: MissingAgentHarnessError race: non-atomic harness registry clear+restore during plugin cache cycle

question: What should the harness registry contract be when plugin loading resolves to an empty active scope?
rationale: Current source shows the user-visible failure class is still plausible, but preserving all previously registered harnesses can violate plugin disablement and empty-scope semantics; automation cannot choose that product/security boundary.

options.title: Preserve Approved Always-On Harnesses
options.body: Filter preservation to maintainer-approved always-on or bundled-provider harnesses, and prove plugin-owned disabled or unscoped harnesses are cleared in loader and gateway paths.

options.title: Accept Restore-All Semantics
options.body: Allow every previously registered harness to survive an empty-scope reload, with explicit maintainer approval and tests documenting that disablement behavior.

options.title: Clear And Add Readiness/Retry
options.body: Keep empty-scope reloads clearing harnesses, but add readiness or bounded retry behavior so channel dispatch does not surface transient missing-harness errors.

recommendation.title: Preserve Approved Always-On Harnesses
recommendation.body: Filter preservation to maintainer-approved always-on or bundled-provider harnesses, and prove plugin-owned disabled or unscoped harnesses are cleared in loader and gateway paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the pluggable harness registry contract introduced in `44ec4d05de4a`, and that history makes steipete the best available routing owner.
